    • add

      public TemporalEdge add(Node before, Action action, Node after)
      Adds a temporal edge to the story graph.
      Parameters:
      before - the tail node, representing the story state before the action
      action - the action that can be taken
      after - the head node, representing the story state after the action is taken
      Returns:
      a new temporal edge with the given tail, label, and head, or the existing edge if that exact edge already exists
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an edge already exists from the tail node for this action but not to the given head node
      IllegalArgumentException - if the tail node, action, or head node have been removed or were not created in this list's story graph
      See Also:
      • TemporalEdgeList.add(Node, Action, Node)

    • add

      public EpistemicEdge add(Node actual, Character character, Node beliefs)
      Adds an epistemic edge to the story graph.
      Parameters:
      actual - the tail node, representing the state the story is actually in
      character - the character that has beliefs
      beliefs - the head node, representing the story state the character beliefs to be the case
      Returns:
      a new epistemic edge with the given tail, label, and head, or the existing edge if that exact edge already exists
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an edge already exists from the tail node for this character but not to the given head node
      IllegalArgumentException - if the tail node, character, or head node have been removed or were not created in this list's story graph
      See Also:
      • EpistemicEdgeList.add(Node, Character, Node)

    • prune

      protected boolean prune(Predicate<Object> predicate, Status status)
      Description copied from class: StoryGraphCollection
      For each element in this collection, this method removes any reference in that element to other elements whose ID numbers have been set to Settings.PRUNED and, if the given predicate returns true, sets the element's ID number to Settings.PRUNED to signal that it should also be removed from this graph. This method does not remove elements from this collection for which the predicate returns true; it only sets their ID numbers to signal that they should later be removed, which typically happens when the collection is renumbered.
      Specified by:
      prune in class StoryGraphCollection<Edge>
      Parameters:
      predicate - a predicate that specifies which elements should be removed from from a story graph
      status - a status object that will be updated while this method runs to reflect its current progress
      Returns:
      true if the predicate returned true for any elements in this collection
